decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - APPROVE

The erection of a single storey side and rear side extension by reason of depth, height, width and appearance is considered to comply with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and alterations) of Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) also Sections 1 (Single storey rear extensions) of Councils' Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the south side elevation wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
